# Tabler Icons attribution

The managed Runtime uses Tabler Icons `v3.46.0` at commit `8ac7d81b72ece11072ef25ea9fd92e80c6f3c9fc` under the MIT License.

The upstream research mirror and the synchronized icon files are intentionally Git-ignored. `runtime/vendor-lock.json` records their pinned identity and tree hash; `tools/vendor/sync_tabler_vendor.ps1` enforces the copy whitelist.
